idea-plugin.name: Throwable Highlighter
idea-plugin.description:
Highlights Throwable and Java classes that inherit from it.

Highlights Throwable types in catch and throws clauses with separate configurable colors. The Throwable catch and Throwable throws colors inherit Throwable class by default.

Highlights class names in Javadoc @throws and @exception tags on methods and constructors. The Throwable Javadoc color inherits Throwable class by default.

Highlights class declarations and references, including uses in fields, local variables, constructor calls, and inheritance declarations.

Highlights the class name in explicit imports of Throwable and its subclasses. Import highlighting inherits the Throwable class color by default.

Configure colors under Editor | Color Scheme | Throwable Highlighter.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.3.0

  • Adds a separate configurable color for Throwable types in throws clauses.
  • Throwable throws inherits the Throwable class color by default.

1.2.0

  • Adds a separate configurable color for Throwable types in catch clauses.
  • Throwable catch inherits the Throwable class color by default.

1.1.0

  • Adds configurable highlighting for imports of Throwable and its subclasses.
  • Highlights only the imported class name.
  • Import highlighting inherits the Throwable class color by default.

1.0.0

  • Highlights Java classes inheriting from Throwable.
  • Highlights both class declarations and references.
  • Supports transitive Throwable inheritance.
  • Adds configurable highlighting under the IDE color scheme settings.
